_comment: THE KNOB REGISTRY. One definition per setting, and the only place a default lives.
docs/routine_config.schema.json  the Routine Configuration Schema the platform reads
Edit this file and re-run the generator; never edit the generated files.
name     the knob, and the environment variable unless 'env' says otherwise
default  what the entrypoint uses when nothing arrives from the platform
blank    what an empty string from the platform means (schemas often send '')
scope    operational | model   -- model knobs change results, operational ones do not
tasks    which TASK values the knob applies to; [] means all

knobs.name: TASK
knobs.label: Workflow / Task
knobs.desc: Which workflow task to run: 'trial' executes a fast trial verification run proving the container, mounts, and interfaces; 'downscale' executes the necessary spatial mediation allocating macro economic targets to 10km grid cells with exact mass conservation; 'swat' runs the SWAT+ water model post-processor; 'biodiversity' runs the Biodiversity Link post-processor; 'postprocess' runs SWAT+ and Biodiversity Link side-by-side on mediated downscaling results; 'all' runs the complete pipeline (downscaling mediation + SWAT+ + Biodiversity Link).

knobs.name: MACRO_MODEL
knobs.label: Macro Economic Model(s)
knobs.desc: Which macro-economic model(s) to process: single model ('globiom'), comma-separated models ('globiom,capri'), or 'all' to process all models in parallel across allocated CPU cores.

knobs.name: INPUT_FILE
knobs.label: Macro Model Input File / Vintage
knobs.desc: Specific macro-economic data vintage to process from the model outputs folder. Select 'latest' to automatically detect the newest date vintage available, or choose a specific vintage from the dropdown menu.

knobs.name: CUSTOM_INPUT_FILE
knobs.label: Custom Macro Input File (Optional Path Override)
knobs.desc: Optional manual file path or external file name for macro-economic data. Defaults to 'none' to use the dropdown selection from Macro Model Input File / Vintage. Enter a path or filename only to override the dropdown.

knobs.name: DOWNSCALE_OUTPUT
knobs.label: Precomputed Downscaling in Target Folder
knobs.desc: Select an available pre-computed 10km downscaling output from the target folder (W:/cascade_gamble_outputs), or 'auto' to automatically match the selected macro model and scenario, or 'none' to force fresh spatial mediation.

knobs.name: POSTMODELS
knobs.label: Subprocessing Environmental Models
knobs.desc: Which subprocessing / post-modelling modules to run side-by-side: 'all' (both SWAT+ and Biodiversity Link), 'swat' (water quality only), 'biodiversity' (ecological intactness only), or 'none'.

knobs.name: SCENARIO
knobs.label: Macro / Policy Scenario(s)
knobs.desc: Scenario(s) to evaluate: 'base' runs the baseline reference path; 'all' runs all standard scenarios (base, mitigation, diet, biodiversity); or pass comma-separated scenarios (e.g. 'base,mitigation'). Multiple scenarios are executed in parallel across allocated CPU cores.

knobs.name: RUN_SWAT
knobs.label: Run Water Quality Model (SWAT+)
knobs.desc: Whether to run SWAT+ water quality simulations (nutrient runoff, nitrogen and phosphorus leaching, streamflow, catchment sediment yield). Set to 1 for on, 0 for off.

knobs.name: RUN_BIODIVERSITY
knobs.label: Run Biodiversity Model (Biodiversity Link)
knobs.desc: Whether to run the Biodiversity Link ecological effects model (Biodiversity Intactness Index BII, cSAR16 committed species extinctions and intactness). Set to 1 for on, 0 for off.

knobs.name: YEARS
knobs.label: Time Horizon / Years
knobs.desc: Simulation years to process. 'all' downscales and simulates all standard time steps (2000, 2010, 2020, 2030, 2040, 2050); or pass comma-separated years.

knobs.name: RESOLUTION
knobs.label: Grid Spatial Resolution
knobs.desc: Target grid resolution for downscaling and subsequent impact assessment. Standard Act4Cap grid is 10km (EEA EPSG:3035).

knobs.name: NCORES
knobs.label: Parallel CPU Cores
knobs.desc: Number of CPU cores allocated for parallel raster processing, IPF gravity allocation, and catchment-level environmental calculations.

knobs.name: TRIAL
knobs.label: Fast Trial Run Mode
knobs.desc: Set to 1 to run a fast trial run over a regional slice, verifying container environment, mounts, and interfaces without full computation. Set to 0 for production.

knobs.name: FORCE
knobs.label: Force Re-run Existing Outputs
knobs.desc: Set to 1 to force re-computation and overwrite existing outputs on the drive. Left at 0 to resume from completed stages.

knobs.name: RUN_DATE
knobs.label: Run Date / Version Date
knobs.desc: Date label used in output directories and filenames (e.g. 'today' or 'YYYYMMDD'). Defaults to 'today' (current execution date).

knobs.name: VERSION_TAG
knobs.label: Custom Output Version Tag
knobs.desc: Custom output version tag appended to all output directories and filenames. Defaults to 'auto' (inherits the chosen macro model output vintage).

knobs.name: WORK_DIR
knobs.label: Persistent Storage Mount (FUSE)
knobs.desc: The cluster FUSE mount path where persistent inputs and outputs are symlinked so the platform retains and collects them at job completion.

knobs.name: OUTPUT_DIR
knobs.label: Output Subdirectory
knobs.desc: Directory where downscaled land use, GeoTIFF indicators, SWAT+ outputs, and Biodiversity Link metrics are written.

knobs.name: INPUT_DIR
knobs.label: Input Subdirectory
knobs.desc: Directory containing macro model tabular data, baseline spatial maps, prior weights, and catchment boundary shapefiles.

knobs.name: CASCADING_GAMBLE_DIR
knobs.label: Cascade Spatial Mediator Path
knobs.desc: Filesystem path to the Cascade downscaling suite acting as the necessary spatial mediator between macro models and environmental post-processors (gamble-cascade / cascadinggamble-core).

knobs.name: SWATPLUS_DIR
knobs.label: SWAT+ Toolkit Directory
knobs.desc: Path to the SWAT+ Python scripts (0-6), default HRU shapefile, and model binaries (e.g. Q:/swatplus_runs locally or /mnt/wdrv/act4cap/swatplus_runs on WKUBE).

knobs.name: BIODIVERSITY_LINK_DIR
knobs.label: Biodiversity Link Repository Path
knobs.desc: Path to the IIASA Biodiversity_Link codebase and input datasets (commit 6cc4443f24663622cbbae6f22dce5428bce6b50d).

knobs.name: BIODIVERSITY_MAPPING_FILE
knobs.label: AgMIP to Biodiversity Link Mapping Table
knobs.desc: Path to CSV table defining the formal crosswalk between downscaled AgMIP land-use classes and IIASA Biodiversity Link categories (lc_type, lc_btc, lc_csar, bii_luclass_f, and bii_luclass_nf).

knobs.name: POSTMODEL_MODE
knobs.label: Post-Modelling Execution Mode
knobs.desc: Execution mode for post-models: 'tentative' runs integrated analytical post-processing with graceful fallbacks; 'full' executes native cluster simulation pipelines; 'trial' executes rapid verification proof.
